2	# Declared configuration disclosure owner proposal
3	
4	Root proposal for RP-DO-04/R23. Not accepted or integrated. Security selects the
5	closed `semantic-configuration-public-fields-v1` policy for the report's resolved
6	configuration projection. This is a useful summary of the actual analysis inputs
7	without copying arbitrary repository strings into the report.
8	
9	## Exact source
10	
11	The source is the retained `semantic-configuration` whose canonical raw SHA-256
12	equals the admitted selected Plan's `resolvedConfigDigest`. The host first
13	admits that Plan and its association with the exact selected Run. The projection
14	checks the complete Plan shape, recomputes its plan2 H identity using the existing canonical owner, and refuses a different caller PlanId. It checks the source configuration schema and recomputes that existing configuration digest, and checks the owned exact budget equality. Full retained digest closure, semantic admission and Run association remain host duties; these checks do not replace them. It never reads current project configuration to fill an older
15	Run's record. A missing, purged, expired or corrupt retained input uses the
16	report's owned unavailable-source state; it is not an empty configuration.
17	
18	This is the **resolved semantic configuration**, not raw declaration files or
19	overridden layers. The existing resolver's winning-layer provenance, operational
20	retention/UI settings and native-context source text are not retained by this
21	semantic configuration commitment. Their absence is stated in the carrier;
22	the report cannot reconstruct or invent them from today's checkout. A future
23	projection for those inputs needs a separately retained, owned source record.
24	This proposal does not change which inputs contribute to Plan/Run identity.
25	
26	## Closed redaction rule
27	
28	The current owner has exactly 13 field slots. Every slot appears as disclosed,
29	redacted, or not-present. Field names come from the pinned schema, never from an
30	untrusted free-form map. Unknown fields or future source schemas fail admission;
31	they are never passed through on a best-effort basis.
32	
33	Only `analysis.budget` and `components.allowedScopes` disclose their exact
34	values. These are a bounded work-unit count and a closed priority choice over
35	global/project scope. Other values are redacted, including profile identifiers,
36	capability arrays, component versions/constraints, policy/waiver identifiers,
37	import identifiers and discovery paths. Array cardinalities are disclosed, but
38	their elements, string lengths, prefixes and per-value hashes are not. There is
39	no keyword heuristic or assumption that a syntactically valid identifier/version
40	cannot contain sensitive information. The existing Plan/configuration commitment
41	is a source identity, not a new value-level fingerprint.
42	
43	Names/descriptions of selected rules and capabilities in their separately
44	admitted public catalogue remain governed by that catalogue owner. Required
45	finding fields, evidence paths, native context disclosures and renderer parity
46	also retain their own contracts. This policy does not claim to redact every
47	other field in a report. It supplies the missing rule for this additional
48	configuration panel without changing those existing surfaces.
49	
50	Missing optional values say not-present. A present empty array says redacted
51	with itemCount 0. Neither is confused with a missing source record. The two
52	public values remain in their original exact types; booleans and floating-point
53	approximations cannot replace integer budgets. Redaction never changes the
54	selected inputs, evaluation, authority, verdict or D9 result.
55	
56	## Host and report integration
57	
58	The policy/schema are compiled selected host inputs, not caller-provided
59	permission to disclose more fields. The reference checks policy coverage and
60	the closed output shape, but its dictionary inputs do not establish runtime
61	authority. The actual host supplies admitted immutable source handles and binds
62	the PlanId to the report's selected Run. The carrier has fixed verifiedInDocument and hostAsserted provenance lists. Document checks cover closed public types and complete fixed field slots. The retained PlanId/configuration digest checks, policy application and exact Run association are host assertions because their preimages are deliberately not embedded. The redacted carrier cannot independently
63	recompute the hidden configuration; that source association is a named host duty.
64	
65	The browser receives only this carrier, not the raw configuration hidden in a
66	script tag, diagnostic, attribute, search index, download or debug object. Tests
67	must inspect the final serialized report as well as the visible text. No current
68	file fallback or secret-bearing refusal text is allowed when construction fails.
69	The existing typed source-availability route owns the public failure; the local
70	reference labels are not new D9 codes.
71	
72	The report carrier successor must add this projection with provenance and its
73	fixed limitations, replace the declared-configuration feature placeholder, and
74	account for its bytes under the existing exploration bound. All 13 field slots
75	are emitted together or the panel carries an explicit bounded/unavailable state;
76	the user must not mistake an omitted field for a default. Static parity and other
77	mandatory findings remain unchanged. Root/actual-Claude selection, source binding,
78	report construction, browser rendering and leakage checks are still required.

81	## Closed source-failure mapping
82	
83	The host classifies retained-source outcomes before projection. Missing, purged
84	and expired map respectively to unavailable/evidence-missing, evidence-purged
85	and evidence-expired. Corrupt retained bytes, malformed retained shape, a
86	configuration digest mismatch, a PlanId mismatch or a budget join mismatch map
87	to corrupt/retained-bytes-corrupt. A retained unsupported schema maps to
88	incompatible/retained-schema-major-unsupported before attempting this version's
89	projection. These are the existing PanelNotPresentV1 states from the pinned

91	host callback input and implementation faults do not masquerade as retained
92	evidence loss. No case produces an empty or current-settings panel.
93

95	excludes both existing source commitments; no new per-value digest is added.
